serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Is something the matter? Your heart rate is up…
You: N-No! Everything is alright!
I can’t really involve her in this, she could make things worse or get hurt…
Bot: Are you sure? You have been spending more time on your PC recently. 
You: W-Well, I have found some online friends, that’s all. 
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
Bot: Oh! Could I chat with them too?
You: W-What?! Did you forget you are a bot? We can’t risk you getting exposed!
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: But I don’t see how they would be able to tell I’m a bot through the internet…
Shit! She’s right!
You: W-well, you know…
#bot.Expression.VerySad
You: P-People on the internet are scary, they have things like captcha and other tools to check for bots, you know? It’s actually easier for you to be found out online than in real life.
Bot: Oh, I see…
Bot: Aren’t we in trouble then? I already chatted with some people and asked questions on forums…
Great, now I made her feel guilty…
You: W-Well, as long as you do it carefully and in moderation, it should be alright…
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: I see! 
Bot: Good thing you told me about it; otherwise I could have accidentally exposed us!
…
You: Anyway, Thank you for being concerned about me, but everything is alright! Really!
Bot: Sure!
Bot: But if there’s a problem, I will help you!
You: Right…
She might be suspecting something…
Bot: I think you got another message.
You: Really?!
